choices.aliases: Mean symmetric KL across training situations; exact max likelihood discrepancy <=1e-12, near KL <.01. Maximum separation within each intervention type.
choices.library: Each piece initially serves end k modulo 3 with a .5 or 1 magnitude. Partial overlap adds a second end to pieces 0 and 1; heavy adds all ends to pieces 2 and 3. Magnitudes drawn independently .5/1 per world.
choices.primary: Realized true-hypothesis log probability after selected intervention minus one extra passive choice, conditional on the same 32-record history. Independent responses.
choices.probe_menu: Six removals, three satiations, two switches, in that tie-breaking order; one-step exact expected information about full hypothesis.
choices.satiation: Set one weight to zero without renormalization; habit bonus unchanged.
choices.truth_sampling: uniform weight/habit conditional on the declared beta setting
choices.weights: step 1/4 simplex, uniform reader prior over 210 hypotheses

inference: descriptive; no confirmation or human claim
known_answers: Exact deterministic fixture controls; tolerance 1e-12. Independent scalar likelihood/posterior route; full output replay and Decimal aggregate review.
name: PIECES_ENDS
reader: exact finite-library posterior; W11 exact individual inference in simulated populations
seed: SHA256 of canonical [v25, scientific packet identity, family, setting index, whole-world index]; probe/study streams disjoint
